episodes.synopsis: While out shopping, Miyo has a chilling vision — only to be surprised by her future father-in-law, who invites her and Kiyoka to their countryside estate.
episodes.title: Another Kudo Residence

episodes.synopsis: Unhappy with her son's engagement, Fuyu commands Miyo to perform housekeeping duties. Meanwhile, Kiyoka makes a shocking discovery at an abandoned house.
episodes.title: A New Ordeal

episodes.synopsis: As Miyo tries to save a villager using Dream-Sight, Kiyoka battles a demon. Later, Arata shares surprising information on the Gifted Communion's founder.
episodes.title: The Gifted Communion and Demons

episodes.synopsis: Upon returning to the capital, the group has an unsettling encounter with Naoshi Usui. Kiyoka assigns Miyo a bodyguard: the dashing Kaoruko Jinnouchi.
episodes.title: What the Autumn Breeze Brought

episodes.synopsis: Miyo overhears soldiers disparaging Kaoruko and defends her friend. Later, she has a troubling nightmare. Is it just a dream or a glimpse of the future?
episodes.title: Deep Within the Heart

episodes.synopsis: As Kiyoka rushes to meet Arata at the imperial family's vacation estate, Usui surprises Miyo and her guards at the dojo, revealing a traitor among them.
episodes.title: The Man Called Naoshi Usui

episodes.synopsis: After a tender New Year's Eve, Miyo and Kiyoka make their first shrine visit together. Meanwhile, Takahito learns of growing unrest in the streets.
episodes.title: A New Year's Commotion

episodes.synopsis: At a surprise gathering, Hazuki and her guests share their thoughts on love. Later, Miyo's worries grow after learning of Takahito's ominous vision.
episodes.title: An Evening Banquet and Distant Snow

episodes.synopsis: While Kiyoka's unit investigates a strange demon, the Gifted Communion makes a ruthless move. Miyo enters a foreboding dream where a young Usui awaits.
episodes.title: Dream Tidings

episodes.synopsis: Determined to save her fiancé, Miyo sneaks out and runs into a young boy with a familiar face. Later, she dreams of a tragic promise from the past.
episodes.title: Promise

episodes.synopsis: After awakening from her dream, Miyo begins to gather allies for the rescue mission. Will her blossoming powers be enough to save Kiyoka and stop Usui?
episodes.title: A Resolute Departure

episodes.synopsis: In the final battle, Usui overwhelms Kiyoka, trapping him in a terrible nightmare. Desperate to prevent more bloodshed, Miyo dives into the dream.
episodes.title: Feelings Beyond Dreams

episodes.synopsis: After the battle, Miyo confides in Arata about her regrets. Kiyoka makes a big life decision. Later, Hazuki surprises Miyo with a heartfelt wedding gift.
episodes.title: Once Spring Has Come
